- Roll back to previous quantization profile (v1.4.1) if latency doesn't improve after initial mitigations.

Quick analysis of the logs Laura attached:
- kvcache eviction count increased 7x at 07:31 UTC, correlated with a spike in pagefaults on the host.
- Frequent full-model reloads for multi-segment prompt patterns (we're seeing repeated cold KV miss on ~12 hot prefixes).
- Per-host memory usage peaked at ~92% which triggered the runtime to OOM-protect and start rejecting new sessions (503).

Immediate mitigations I recommend (in order):
1) Increase kvcache pool from 6GB -> 8GB on the busiest hosts (safe, config change + rolling restart per host).
2) Add small LRU pinning for the 12 hot prefixes (will reduce repeated reloads). I can push a pin-patch to the config in 25 minutes for a canary host.
3) Temporarily reduce batching to target median latency (batch_size cap to 16) to prevent large batching during bursts.

Attached: server_logs_20280730.txt (annotated), kvcache_sample.json (small sample).

If we go for 1) + 2) now on a single canary host, we should expect to see p95 drop within one minute after the canary finishes warming.

Marcus
